forms.label: Fresh
forms.sourceNote: Spearmint, fresh. Public domain. The record carries no sugars figure, so sugarGPer100 is left off here rather than estimated. No density is carried: the leaf is muddled and bruised rather than poured, and its own record's only volume figure is a packed tablespoon, which is air between leaves rather than what the leaf itself displaces.

forms.label: Dried
forms.sourceNote: Spearmint, dried. Public domain. USDA reports no sugars for this record, so sugarGPer100 is left off rather than estimated. No density: crumbled dried leaf stirred into a drink is packed, not poured, and its own tsp measure (0.101 g/ml) is a packing figure.
